Updates |

Extended Harvest Hours -
Monday, October 19th | 7:30am - Full |
Farmer Online Portal - CIH https://highwater.cihedging.com/cih/grower/login.cfm
DP Program:
Our current DP Program for Fall 2026 is in effect from Friday, October 9th, 2026 to Monday, August 30th, 2027. The cost is $0.065 per month - prorated daily. These bushels MUST be priced out by Monday, August 30th, 2027 or they will be automatically priced out and payment will be sent. We will maintain our normal discount schedule (no shrink). You may NOT move DP bushels to forward contracts. You may not roll an old DP Program into a new DP Program.

Mission Statement |
|
|
Mission Statement :
To successfully operate a bio-energy facility, which will be profitable to our investor owners while contributing to the economic growth in the region. Highwater Ethanol is committed to the present while focusing on the future.
Vision Statement :
Highwater Ethanol will identify opportunities that position the business to provide sustainable competitive advantages through short and long term core investments.
